title: Excessive JSON marshal/unmarshal churn
summary: Repeatedly marshaling and unmarshaling the same data or using JSON as an internal handoff format.
rationale: Serialization churn wastes CPU and allocation, especially in service-to-service or queue-heavy flows.

detection.notes: Detect json.Marshal followed by json.Unmarshal, map[string]any conversions, or internal JSON round-trips.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Pass typed structures, stream encode/decode, avoid unnecessary round-trips, or use more efficient internal formats.
remediation.tradeoffs: JSON remains useful at boundaries; focus on internal repeated transformations.
